nulls.title: 4096 Hz is not the electromagnetic surface-wave carrier

result.interpretation: the structure is electrically tiny at the candidate frequency: it cannot support a bound annular surface-wave resonance there. The candidate frequency is retained as a SWITCHING and PHASE reference, which is what the source record actually describes, and NOT as the electromagnetic carrier. This is a NULL result for the carrier reading, not a failure of the device concept.

nulls.ordinary_explanation: the annulus is 1e-5 wavelengths around at 4096 Hz; it is an electrically tiny quasi-static object there. 4096 Hz is a switching and phase reference, which is what the source record describes.
nulls.what_would_change_it: a structure with a slow-wave factor above 1e5, i.e. a resonator ~5 orders larger or a genuinely different physical mechanism

nulls.title: Space-time nonreciprocity does not engage at 16 Hz modulation

scale_separation.consequence: all sidebands fall inside one resonance linewidth: the modulation is adiabatic with respect to the mode, and no nonreciprocal space-time gap opens. Any force is the ordinary quasi-static reaction, not a modulation effect

nonreciprocity.interpretation: the modulation offset is far smaller than the resonance linewidth, so forward and reversed modulation address the same resonance identically. No space-time nonreciprocal gap opens, and the contrast below is a numerical floor, not a physical effect.

nulls.ordinary_explanation: sidebands sit ~6 orders inside one resonance linewidth; the modulation is adiabatic with respect to the mode
nulls.what_would_change_it: Q above 3.6e7, or modulation raised into the MHz range comparable with the linewidth

nulls.title: Constructed harmonic field model did not converge and was withdrawn

result.symptom: lateral force changed by 9-44 percent per harmonic-truncation step and never settled
result.diagnosis: the constructed field was not a solution of Laplace's equation and lacked the m-dependent radial decay that makes a multipole sum converge; the finite-aperture sinc factor does not decay over m<=16 for a 35-cell pitch and did not rescue it
result.resolution: replaced with exact superposed Coulomb fields, which need no truncation; force is now invariant to 15 significant figures under integration-surface placement

nulls.ordinary_explanation: a modelling error, found by an independent convergence dimension and published rather than hidden

nulls.title: Isolated distribution has zero self-force; no configuration produces unbalanced momentum
nulls.ordinary_explanation: lateral force is an ordinary m=1 asymmetry force balanced by the support reaction; momentum closes
nulls.what_would_change_it: a momentum ledger that fails to close once every body is included

nulls.title: Exactly diametric omitted-cell pair is impossible on an odd cell count

result.reason: cells=35 is odd, so no pair of indices is separated by exactly pi; the nearest available separation is used instead and is reported as nearest_diametric_gaps

nulls.ordinary_explanation: arithmetic: no pair of 35 equally spaced indices differs by exactly pi
